name: Abekura Karin
source:
A girl who admires [url=/c31648]Eri[/url]. She dislikes [url=/c31650]Itsuki[/url] for being so close to Eri, and looks at him as a rival. Karin has many enemies in the school because of her rough appearance, tone and behavior, which do not suit a young lady. However, because of her caring personality, she is loved by some girls from her school.
